name: deepmatch
description: DeepMatch greenfield monorepo — matching, chat, couple map, concierge, personal, admin

scripts.build: npm run build -w @deepmatch/shared && npm run build -w @deepmatch/web && npm run build -w @deepmatch/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @deepmatch/shared && npm run lint -w @deepmatch/web && npm run lint -w @deepmatch/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @deepmatch/shared && npm run typecheck -w @deepmatch/web && npm run typecheck -w @deepmatch/admin
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
